newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Blanco predicts August CPI at 1.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Blanco predicts August CPI at 1.3 pct.

text.p: Mexican Commerce Minister Herminio Blanco on Friday forecast August inflation of about 1.3 percent.
"We have half the inflation we had a year ago and we expect that for the month of August we will have inflation close to 1.3 percent," Blanco said during testimony to Mexico's Congress.
Banco de Mexico is expected to release August inflation data on Monday.
A Reuters survey of local economists MXAAP forecast August inflation of 1.36 percent.
Blanco told legislators that Mexico had emerged from its economic crisis and was on the road to recovery.
